answer: Like a prism refracting raw energy into crystallization, our consensus relies on mutual stake validation. Each peer tests an unverified node like cracking a hard walnut shell before acknowledging its root. A rogue entity cannot simply multiply identities to conquer this network, because routing trust through interconnected clusters scales verification burdens superlinearly: any isolated attacker attempting to forge an island of fake agents faces an exponential cost escalation that rapidly exhausts their capital.
